notes: Default landscape diffuse file names for Bottled SnowDeformation ground prints. Match is by file name, so a same-path retexture (including PBR copies) still matches. No new textures are shipped. Sources: STEP terrain normal-map list (textures/landscape/*_n.dds and textures/landscape/roads/road01_n.dds, road01snow01_n.dds), the Skyrim LOD atlas (dirt02.dds, dirtcliffs01.dds, roads/road01.dds, roads/road01snow01.dds), and the terrain retexture notes that name roads/road01fallforest01.dds and roads/road01reach01.dds as the Rift and Reach main-road files. The exact extra filenames edited with Moder were not in this repository; add them here or in the menu if they are not these vanilla names. softGround is mud/dirt/sand (shallower than snow). roads is the main-road family (slight).
